content: Mɛ, Pɔl, mɛ an'lɔm akà bɛ, unsà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n anà ubwaŋ a Klistɔ, - bää mɛ in'fàkal unsà un'kaay u mii abɛ, wɛɛ wàŋàtsim mpal in'fàkal mɛ ukwɛl,
mɛ amàlabɔɔn: twon làman'siinà a ngwal utaaŋ in'yàkal mɛ paa, ntɔn ndaa a ngwal in'kwo mɛ muswaŋ akà baar bàfàsi naa nsyeel a mpem abi yunsà imbuur.
Ndandaa, bi ibà baar, wɛɛ bi ifànwan anki unsà ndür.
Ntɔn an'tà ifànwan bi amà kà mimbuur anki, wɛɛ ngwal ama yan'fà akà Nzam ntɔn mubwiy ikal a ngwal. Bi ifàpay an'yweerà an'be,
anà ngwal yanswà ifàmbäär ngyööb a Nzam. Bi ifàkɔr an'kyän manswà ntɔn ma ikyey Klistɔ.
Bi ibàŋàyöŋà mupà ntaaŋàmbar akà unkwem banswà, umpal làsàmɛy bɛ unkyeey abɛ wàŋàkwo.
Làler indiir asànaa ibyà bya. Isàkal naa we anà mbuur akakyeyà uyɔl naa nde wà Klistɔ, wɛy nde uyweer anà uyöb naa: bi sye ibà bà Klistɔ asànaa nde!
Abun, itàkal naa mɛ in'we anà uyɔl aŋàsöönà ikye unsà ikɔ̈b kipɛ Mwol ntɔn mutɔŋ, kà ntɔn mudwa anki, mɛ nswɛn in'yàman anki.
Mɛ in'kwen anki mukal anà ifà mupà bɛ bɔɔmà unsà in'kaan amɛ,
ntɔn, bàfàtɛn naa: « In'kaan ande myàfàkal ngwal anà myàfàpà bɔɔmà, wɛɛ umpal awà nde paa, nde wàgyɔ̈ɔ̈là, ndaa ande ndöŋ yatɛy. »
Wɛɛ mbuur akatɛɛnà abwɛy, uyöb ubwaŋ naa: asànaa ibà bi unsà in'kaan abi ukwel, bi sye iyàkal abun u nsyääl abi utaaŋ iyàkal bi uboo a bɛ.
Ndandaa, bi ikwe anki musi a baar bumwɛy abà bàfàswɛɛŋ ba ŋakwo. Ba bà insil: ba bàfàwal ba ŋakwo asànaa isii musi a ba ŋakwo.
Wɛɛ akà bi, bi iyàlyaŋ anki isii unsà ngaal ifàswaŋ bi, wɛɛ bi, bi iyàsyääl isii a ndel a isal kisyeel Nzam, mukitwääl sye tii akà bɛ.
Ntɔn, bi ilyaŋ anki ndel abi, asànaa bi kàyi anki akà bɛ. Ndandaa bi ibà baar atàtwɛb bàtöl apà bɛ anà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Klistɔ.
Abun, bi ngaal aŋàsöönà ifàswaŋ anki unsà isal a mbuur asin, wɛɛ bi ibye anà làkyän naa làkwikilà abɛ làsàyɛl, bi iyàfàyɛl aŋàsöönà uboo a bɛ, unsà ndel a isal abi,
mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ uboo a itiir abyukwel anà bɛ, mukɔɔn aswaŋ ngaal unsà isal bàkyer u ywaŋ a baar asin.
Apan sye, bàsön naa: « Wɛy mbuur aswaŋà ngaal, uswɛŋ ngaal ande unsà Mwol. »
Abun, kà bàfàkyey mbuur afàswɛɛŋ nde ŋakwo anki, wɛɛ mbuur awà ufàswɛɛŋ Mwol.
